setup.title: Welcome to sitesteward
setup.intro: Create the password for your agency panel. You will need it every time you log in.
setup.codeHelp: Shown in the terminal / container log where sitesteward was started. It proves you own this server.

dash.title: Dashboard
dash.subtitle: All your clients' websites at a glance.
dash.emptyText: Add your first client and their website. Checks start right away.

site.name: Website name
site.keywordHelp: If this text is missing from the page, the site counts as down.
site.ignoreHelp: For example "casino" for a hotel next to a casino.
site.pausedHelp: Monitoring is paused for this website. Paused time is not counted in uptime or reports.
site.spamHelp: Check the homepage source. If the words are legitimate, add them to the ignore list below.

client.name: Client name
client.emailHelp: Where the monthly report is sent.
client.statusPublic: Public status page for this client
client.newIntro: A client can have one or more websites. You will add them on the next screen.
client.delete: Delete client and all its data

reports.title: Monthly reports
reports.linkHelp: Anyone with this link can see the report. It is long and random, and search engines are asked not to index it.
reports.pdfHelp: For a PDF, open the report and press "Save as PDF".
reports.work: What we did this month (one item per line)
reports.workPh:
Updated WordPress and 12 plugins
Renewed the SSL certificate
Fixed the contact form
reports.workHelp: Pre-filled from the work log. Clients love seeing this – it is why they pay you.
reports.nextPh:
Add a cookie banner
Compress the large photos on the homepage
reports.confirmRefresh: This report was already sent. Rebuild its numbers from the current data? The client's link will show the new numbers.
reports.confirmRotate: The old link will stop working. Continue?
reports.cannotEmail: To send by e-mail: add the client's report e-mail, the SMTP settings and the public URL in Settings.

work.title: Work log
work.help: Write down what you do for this client during the month. It goes into the next report automatically.

settings.timezoneHelp: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Sofia or America/New_York.
settings.publicUrlHelp: Used for report links in e-mails, e.g. https://monitor.example.com
settings.retriesHelp: Avoids false alarms from short network hiccups.
settings.spamWords: Spam words (signs of a hacked site)
settings.spamHelp: Comma separated. Searched in the homepage HTML, whole words only.
settings.modeManual: On the 1st: create drafts and notify me (I review and press Send)
settings.modeAuto: On the 1st: create and e-mail reports to clients automatically
settings.reportHour: Hour of the day (your time zone)
settings.pdfOn: PDF engine found: reports can be downloaded as PDF and are attached to e-mails.
settings.pdfOff: No PDF engine installed: clients use "Save as PDF" in their browser (the report has an A4 print layout). Optional: npm install playwright.
settings.smtpHelp: Used to send reports to clients and e-mail alerts to you. Any provider works (Gmail app password, Brevo, Mailgun, your hosting...).
settings.smtpSecure: Use SSL/TLS from the start (port 465). Otherwise STARTTLS is used.
settings.alertsHelp: Where you get notified when a site goes down, a certificate or domain is about to expire, or a hack is suspected.
settings.backupHelp: Downloads a consistent copy of the whole database: clients, check history, reports and settings – including the saved SMTP and alert passwords. Keep it somewhere safe. To restore: stop sitesteward, then replace sitesteward.db in the data directory with this file.
settings.dryRun: DRY RUN mode: nothing is really sent. Alerts and e-mails are only written to the log.
